_source: Source spellings that do not fold onto a Census county NAME, keyed 'ST|folded source name' -> list of GEOIDs. Only partial-state lists need these; whole-state entries never do. '_why' records the reason for each.

_why.TX|cottledallam: Dallas PDF (2018) runs 'Cottle, Dallam' together with a missing comma.
_why.WI|washbum: Saint Paul PDF and consulmex page misspell Washburn County.
_why.WI|sewyer: Saint Paul PDF and consulmex page misspell Sawyer County.
